E1 describes a similar thermo-mechanical processing route producing a hierarchical ultrafine duplex structure with improved properties, though it does not specify cryogenic temperatures. The cited evidence thus strongly supports the key premises, with only a minor gap regarding the explicit cryogenic condition in E1.
premises: Cryogenic rolling followed by annealing refines the lamellar microstructure of AlCoCrFeNi2.1 into a hierarchical ultrafine duplex structure
This refined structure increases both strength and ductility relative to the as-cast state
The mechanism involves increased coherent phase boundaries blocking dislocations and strain gradients promoting uniform flow
The effect holds under optimized rolling reduction and annealing parameters that avoid coarsening or damage
The baseline as-cast alloy exhibits a strength-ductility trade-off due to its coarse lamellar structure
